page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at top right; a catchword-like word "in" at the lower right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: propelli, etiam tum temporis, quando è ventriculo ad intestina alimenta fermentata non propelluntur: adeoque hîc nihil otiosum esse præter rudem censuram Doctoris Le Vasseur; Imò quia hoc loco negat bilem & Succum pancreaticum in duodenum profluere, cum nullum ad intestina deducitur alimentum; atque pag. 16. negat quoque bilem ad intestina profluere cum alimentum sive cibus in stomacho fermentatus eò deducitur, sequitur ex absona hac Doctoris Le Vasseur sententia omninò frustra esse duƈtum bilarium intestinalem tam manifestum, & per quem bilem effundi, præter auƈtoritatem Galeni modò citatam, manifestissimâ probatur experientiâ, adeò ut ex frustra proposita illius argumentatione sequatur aliquid in humano corpore frustra esse, quod, velut prorsus absonum, totius illius disputationis basim posuerat. page.notes: Pag. 16 is a printed marginal-style reference inside the text. The catchword "in" is taken as the word at the lower right. Some letters are faint (e.g. "bafim", "pofuerat") and the 's' long s has been normalised to s. Several words are printed with faded ink; no illegibility was found.
